description: Every update in one pull request a week (group:all, schedule:weekly: Monday before 4 AM UTC), majors included (group:all sets separateMajorMinor false), each past the 3-day minimum release age, except GitHub Actions', which come in a weekly pull request of their own (below). An agent folds the week's pull request into one of ours with `cargo xtask pr renovate <number>`, which re-applies the whole group, pins what needs pins and fixes what breaks. Packages that must move together (the Rust toolchain and every rust-version, React and its types, Tailwind CSS and its Vite plugin, oxlint and oxlint-tsgolint, Vitest and its coverage provider, tailscaled and Go) move together because everything does; the Dependency Dashboard (config:best-practices) lists what is pending.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: refreshing Cargo.lock would pull transitive versions that never passed the 3-day minimum release age. Transitive updates arrive only with age-gated direct updates.

packageRules.description: Hold tokio-tungstenite at the version axum's ws feature depends on (0.29 for axum 0.8.9 in Cargo.lock): cargo-deny refuses two versions of a crate in the lockfile, and #18 and #26 proposed a tokio-tungstenite axum did not take yet. When an axum update needs a newer tokio-tungstenite, the weekly pull request fails cargo-deny's duplicate check: raise this bound to that version's successor and bump the workspace's tokio-tungstenite in the pull request that folds it.

The web app's npm packages (web/package.json, locked in web/pnpm-lock.yaml): exact versions, which pnpm-workspace.yaml's savePrefix keeps, past the same 3-day minimum release age that pnpm's minimumReleaseAge enforces at install.
node in xtask/tools.toml stays on an LTS line: Renovate proposes no odd-numbered, short-lived major.

tailscaled and the Go that builds it (packaging/tailscale.toml) move together, as every update does here: `cargo xtask release go` refuses a Go other than the one Tailscale's go.mod names. go.dev's archive sha256s are pinned beside the version, and Renovate cannot compute them.
prBodyNotes: When Go's version changes, copy the sha256 go.dev publishes for each of the three archives in `packaging/tailscale.toml` from https://go.dev/dl/ and commit them: the release workflow refuses any other archive.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions updates come in a weekly pull request of their own, which the maintainer reviews and merges as Renovate opened it: the agent App cannot push a workflow change, so `cargo xtask pr renovate` cannot fold one, and none needs a pin of ours (Renovate pins each action's digest itself, with its version in a comment, as pinact checks).
Pinned tools need new checksums with every version.
prBodyNotes: Renovate cannot pin, and `cargo xtask setup` refuses archives whose sha256 is not pinned, so this pull request is not merged: an agent runs `cargo xtask pr renovate <number>`, which re-applies every update here on main, pins the bumped tools, opens a replacement and closes this one with a link to it.

node in xtask/tools.toml, released on nodejs.org.
The tailscaled abc's Homebrew formula carries (packaging/tailscale.toml): Tailscale's release and the commit its tag names.
The Go that builds abc's tailscaled (packaging/tailscale.toml): the version Tailscale's go.mod names.
